item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect partly cloudy skies with lows ranging from the upper thirties to the low forties and no significant precipitation. Tomorrow brings mostly clear to partly cloudy conditions with highs from the mid-sixties to near seventy, but a slight chance of rain showers develops late tomorrow night as skies turn mostly cloudy and lows settle in the upper forties. Looking ahead to Friday, skies trend partly to mostly cloudy with highs in the mid-fifties to upper fifties and little to no precipitation expected.
